alt_text: The chair has a high, rounded back and integrated curved arms, with vertical channel stitching and a separate rectangular seat cushion. The chair is upholstered in white, with a separate rectangular white cushion placed against the backrest, and rests on a white five-spoke wheeled base with black-and-white casters; a black adjustment lever extends beneath the seat on the left side. A desk and laptop are positioned behind the chair.
